questions.q: When Jesus asks 'Who do you say I am?', how would you answer him today?
questions.answer: One example: "I believe you're God, not just a good teacher, so I need to actually follow you, not just admire what you taught."

questions.q: Why is it easier to call Jesus a good teacher than to call him God?
questions.answer: A good teacher's advice can be ignored when it's inconvenient, but if Jesus is God, I'm accountable to Him, and that asks a lot more of my life.

questions.q: What evidence backs up who you say you are, and what backs up who Jesus is?
questions.answer: For me it's what I actually do, like a player who scored 35 points. For Jesus: He claimed God's own name, "I am," forgave sins, accepted worship and did miracles.
